   124	private theorem quantitative_native_passing_term_le
   125	    (P : AdmissibleParams) (e : ℝ) (he : 0 ≤ e) :
   126	    let r : ℝ := ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) / (P.q : ℝ)
   127	    let passing := directPassingErrorEnvelope
   128	      (pauliBaselinePointError e + (P.m : ℝ) *
   129	        pauliBaselineExtendedLineError e r) r
   130	    Real.rpow (3 * passing) quantitativeLowDegreePower ≤
   131	      2 * (Real.rpow e (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 16) +
   132	        Real.rpow (P.m : ℝ) (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 2) *
   133	          Real.rpow e (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 512) +
   134	        Real.rpow (P.m : ℝ) (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 2) *
   135	          Real.rpow r (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 32) +
   136	        Real.rpow r quantitativeLowDegreePower) := by
   137	  intro r passing
   138	  let Q := pauliBaselinePointError e
   139	  let L := (P.m : ℝ) * pauliBaselineExtendedLineError e r
   140	  have hr : 0 ≤ r := by dsimp [r]; positivity
   141	  have hm0 : 0 ≤ (P.m : ℝ) := by positivity
   142	  have hpointConstant : 0 ≤ pauliBaselinePointConstant :=
   143	    le_trans zero_le_one one_le_pauli_baseline_point_constant
   144	  have hextendedConstant : 0 ≤ pauliBaselineExtendedLineConstant :=
   145	    le_trans zero_le_one one_le_pauli_baseline_extended_line_constant
   146	  have hQ : 0 ≤ Q := by
   147	    dsimp [Q, pauliBaselinePointError]
   148	    positivity
   149	  have hL : 0 ≤ L := by
   150	    dsimp [L, pauliBaselineExtendedLineError]
   151	    positivity
   152	  have htau0 : 0 ≤ quantitativeLowDegreePower := by
   153	    unfold quantitativeLowDegreePower
   154	    norm_num
   155	  have htau1 : quantitativeLowDegreePower ≤ 1 := by
   156	    unfold quantitativeLowDegreePower
   157	    norm_num
   158	  have hQroot : Real.sqrt Q =
   159	      Real.sqrt pauliBaselinePointConstant * Real.rpow e (1 / 16 : ℝ) := by
   160	    dsimp [Q, pauliBaselinePointError]
   161	    rw [Real.sqrt_mul hpointConstant, sqrt_rpow_eq he]
   162	    congr 1
   163	    ring
   164	  have hsumRoot : Real.sqrt
   165	      (Real.rpow e (1 / 256 : ℝ) + Real.rpow r (1 / 16 : ℝ)) ≤
   166	      Real.rpow e (1 / 512 : ℝ) + Real.rpow r (1 / 32 : ℝ) := by
   167	    have h := sqrt_add_le_add_sqrt
   168	      (Real.rpow_nonneg he (1 / 256 : ℝ))
   169	      (Real.rpow_nonneg hr (1 / 16 : ℝ))
   170	    rw [sqrt_rpow_eq he, sqrt_rpow_eq hr] at h
   171	    convert h using 1 <;> ring
   172	  have hLroot : Real.sqrt L ≤
   173	      Real.sqrt (P.m : ℝ) * Real.sqrt pauliBaselineExtendedLineConstant *
   174	        (Real.rpow e (1 / 512 : ℝ) + Real.rpow r (1 / 32 : ℝ)) := by
   175	    dsimp [L, pauliBaselineExtendedLineError]
   176	    rw [Real.sqrt_mul hm0,
   177	      Real.sqrt_mul hextendedConstant]
   178	    simpa only [mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsumRoot
   179	      (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg (P.m : ℝ))
   180	        (Real.sqrt_nonneg pauliBaselineExtendedLineConstant))
   181	  have hQLroot : Real.sqrt (Q + L) ≤ Real.sqrt Q + Real.sqrt L :=
   182	    sqrt_add_le_add_sqrt hQ hL
   183	  have hfirst : Real.rpow (9 * Real.sqrt Q) quantitativeLowDegreePower ≤
   184	      2 * Real.rpow e (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 16) := by
   185	    rw [hQroot]
   186	    calc
   187	      Real.rpow (9 * (Real.sqrt pauliBaselinePointConstant *
   188	          Real.rpow e (1 / 16 : ℝ))) quantitativeLowDegreePower =
   189	          Real.rpow (9 * Real.sqrt pauliBaselinePointConstant)
   190	              quantitativeLowDegreePower *
   191	            Real.rpow (Real.rpow e (1 / 16 : ℝ))
   192	              quantitativeLowDegreePower := by
   193	        rw [show 9 * (Real.sqrt pauliBaselinePointConstant *
   194	            Real.rpow e (1 / 16 : ℝ)) =
   195	          (9 * Real.sqrt pauliBaselinePointConstant) *
   196	            Real.rpow e (1 / 16 : ℝ) by ring,
   197	          Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (Real.rpow_nonneg he _)
   198	            quantitativeLowDegreePower]
   199	      _ = Real.rpow (9 * Real.sqrt pauliBaselinePointConstant)
   200	              quantitativeLowDegreePower *
   201	            Real.rpow e (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 16) := by
   202	        rw [rpow_rpow_eq he]
   203	        congr 1
   204	        ring
   205	      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
   206	        nine_sqrt_point_constant_rpow_le_two (Real.rpow_nonneg he _)
   207	  have hsecond : Real.rpow (9 * Real.sqrt L) quantitativeLowDegreePower ≤
   208	      2 * (Real.rpow (P.m : ℝ) (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 2) *
   209	          Real.rpow e (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 512) +
   210	        Real.rpow (P.m : ℝ) (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 2) *
   211	          Real.rpow r (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 32)) := by
   212	    have hmono := Real.rpow_le_rpow
   213	      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 9) (Real.sqrt_nonneg L))
   214	      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLroot (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 9)) htau0
   215	    calc
   216	      Real.rpow (9 * Real.sqrt L) quantitativeLowDegreePower ≤
   217	          Real.rpow
   218	            ((9 * Real.sqrt pauliBaselineExtendedLineConstant) *
   219	              (Real.sqrt (P.m : ℝ) *
   220	                (Real.rpow e (1 / 512 : ℝ) + Real.rpow r (1 / 32 : ℝ))))
   221	            quantitativeLowDegreePower := by
   222	        convert hmono using 1 <;> ring
   223	      _ = Real.rpow (9 * Real.sqrt pauliBaselineExtendedLineConstant)
   224	              quantitativeLowDegreePower *
   225	            Real.rpow (Real.sqrt (P.m : ℝ) *
   226	              (Real.rpow e (1 / 512 : ℝ) + Real.rpow r (1 / 32 : ℝ)))
   227	              quantitativeLowDegreePower := by
   228	        exact Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (by positivity)
   229	          quantitativeLowDegreePower
   230	      _ ≤ 2 * Real.rpow (Real.sqrt (P.m : ℝ) *
   231	              (Real.rpow e (1 / 512 : ℝ) + Real.rpow r (1 / 32 : ℝ)))
   232	              quantitativeLowDegreePower :=
   233	        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right nine_sqrt_extended_constant_rpow_le_two
   234	          (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _)
   235	      _ = 2 * (Real.rpow (P.m : ℝ) (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 2) *
   236	            Real.rpow
   237	              (Real.rpow e (1 / 512 : ℝ) + Real.rpow r (1 / 32 : ℝ))
   238	              quantitativeLowDegreePower) := by
   239	        rw [Real.mul_rpow (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (by positivity)
   240	          quantitativeLowDegreePower, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow,
   241	          rpow_rpow_eq hm0]
   242	        congr 2
   243	        ring
   244	      _ ≤ 2 * (Real.rpow (P.m : ℝ) (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 2) *
   245	          (Real.rpow (Real.rpow e (1 / 512 : ℝ)) quantitativeLowDegreePower +
   246	            Real.rpow (Real.rpow r (1 / 32 : ℝ)) quantitativeLowDegreePower)) := by
   247	        gcongr
   248	        exact Real.rpow_add_le_add_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg he _)
   249	          (Real.rpow_nonneg hr _) htau0 htau1
   250	      _ = _ := by
   251	        rw [rpow_rpow_eq he, rpow_rpow_eq hr]
   252	        congr 1 <;> ring
   253	  have hthird : Real.rpow (9 * r) quantitativeLowDegreePower ≤
   254	      2 * Real.rpow r quantitativeLowDegreePower := by
   255	    calc
   256	      Real.rpow (9 * r) quantitativeLowDegreePower =
   257	          Real.rpow 9 quantitativeLowDegreePower *
   258	            Real.rpow r quantitativeLowDegreePower :=
   259	        Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) hr quantitativeLowDegreePower
   260	      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
   261	        nine_rpow_quantitative_low_degree_power_le_two
   262	        (Real.rpow_nonneg hr _)
   263	  have hrootMono : Real.rpow (9 * Real.sqrt (Q + L)) quantitativeLowDegreePower ≤
   264	      Real.rpow (9 * (Real.sqrt Q + Real.sqrt L)) quantitativeLowDegreePower :=
   265	    Real.rpow_le_rpow (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
   266	      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQLroot (by norm_num)) htau0
   267	  have hrootSplit : Real.rpow (9 * (Real.sqrt Q + Real.sqrt L))
   268	      quantitativeLowDegreePower ≤
   269	      Real.rpow (9 * Real.sqrt Q) quantitativeLowDegreePower +
   270	        Real.rpow (9 * Real.sqrt L) quantitativeLowDegreePower := by
   271	    rw [mul_add]
   272	    exact Real.rpow_add_le_add_rpow
   273	      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.sqrt_nonneg Q))
   274	      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.sqrt_nonneg L)) htau0 htau1
   275	  have hfinal :
   276	      Real.rpow (9 * (Real.sqrt (Q + L) + r)) quantitativeLowDegreePower ≤
   277	        2 * (Real.rpow e (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 16) +
   278	          Real.rpow (P.m : ℝ) (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 2) *
   279	            Real.rpow e (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 512) +
   280	          Real.rpow (P.m : ℝ) (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 2) *
   281	            Real.rpow r (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 32) +
   282	          Real.rpow r quantitativeLowDegreePower) := by
   283	    calc
   284	      Real.rpow (9 * (Real.sqrt (Q + L) + r)) quantitativeLowDegreePower =
   285	          Real.rpow (9 * Real.sqrt (Q + L) + 9 * r)
   286	            quantitativeLowDegreePower := by congr 1; ring
   287	      _ ≤ Real.rpow (9 * Real.sqrt (Q + L)) quantitativeLowDegreePower +
   288	          Real.rpow (9 * r) quantitativeLowDegreePower :=
   289	        Real.rpow_add_le_add_rpow
   290	          (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
   291	          (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hr) htau0 htau1
   292	      _ ≤ (Real.rpow (9 * Real.sqrt Q) quantitativeLowDegreePower +
   293	            Real.rpow (9 * Real.sqrt L) quantitativeLowDegreePower) +
   294	          Real.rpow (9 * r) quantitativeLowDegreePower :=
   295	        add_le_add hrootSplit le_rfl
   296	      _ ≤ (2 * Real.rpow e (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 16) +
   297	            2 * (Real.rpow (P.m : ℝ) (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 2) *
   298	                Real.rpow e (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 512) +
   299	              Real.rpow (P.m : ℝ) (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 2) *
   300	                Real.rpow r (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 32))) +
   301	          2 * Real.rpow r quantitativeLowDegreePower :=
   302	        add_le_add (add_le_add hfirst hsecond) hthird
   303	      _ = _ := by ring
   304	  simpa only [passing, directPassingErrorEnvelope, Q, L] using hfinal

   306	/-- Every fractional power of the exact native direct low-degree error is
   307	bounded by the unit-capped six-term expression, with numerical coefficients
   308	kept outside all parameter powers. -/
   309	theorem quantitative_native_error_rpow_le_separated
   310	    (P : AdmissibleParams) (e s : ℝ) (he : 0 ≤ e)
   311	    (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
   312	    let r : ℝ := ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) / (P.q : ℝ)
   313	    let passing := directPassingErrorEnvelope
   314	      (pauliBaselinePointError e + (P.m : ℝ) *
   315	        pauliBaselineExtendedLineError e r) r
   316	    Real.rpow (directNativeError P.extendedDirectLd passing) s ≤
   317	      quantitativeNativeSeparatedError P e s := by
   318	  intro r passing
   319	  let h : ℝ := (2 * P.m + 2 : ℕ)
   320	  let d : ℝ := P.d
   321	  let field : ℝ := d / (P.q : ℝ)
   322	  let passTerm := Real.rpow (3 * passing) quantitativeLowDegreePower
   323	  let tail := Real.exp (-(4 * h * d))
   324	  let raw := 400000 * Real.rpow h (5 / 4 : ℝ) *
   325	    Real.rpow d (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (passTerm + Real.rpow field
   326	      quantitativeLowDegreePower + tail)
   327	  have hr : 0 ≤ r := by dsimp [r]; positivity
   328	  have hh : 0 ≤ h := by dsimp [h]; positivity
   329	  have hd : 0 ≤ d := by dsimp [d]; positivity
   330	  have hfield : 0 ≤ field := by dsimp [field]; positivity
   331	  have hpassing : 0 ≤ passing := by
   332	    dsimp [passing, directPassingErrorEnvelope]
   333	    positivity
   334	  have hpassTerm : 0 ≤ passTerm := Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _
   335	  have hfieldTerm : 0 ≤ Real.rpow field quantitativeLowDegreePower :=
   336	    Real.rpow_nonneg hfield _
   337	  have htail : 0 ≤ tail := by dsimp [tail]; positivity
   338	  have hraw : 0 ≤ raw := by dsimp [raw]; positivity
   339	  have hlambda0 : 0 ≤ directNativeError P.extendedDirectLd passing :=
   340	    direct_native_error_nonneg _ hpassing
   341	  have hlambdaRaw : directNativeError P.extendedDirectLd passing ≤ raw := by
   342	    unfold directNativeError
   343	    exact min_le_right _ _
   344	  have hpass := quantitative_native_passing_term_le P e he
   345	  have hpass' : passTerm ≤ 2 *
   346	      (Real.rpow e (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 16) +
   347	        Real.rpow (P.m : ℝ) (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 2) *
   348	          Real.rpow e (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 512) +
   349	        Real.rpow (P.m : ℝ) (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 2) *
   350	          Real.rpow r (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 32) +
   351	        Real.rpow r quantitativeLowDegreePower) := by
   352	    simpa only [r, passing] using hpass
   353	  let a := Real.rpow e (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 16)
   354	  let b := Real.rpow (P.m : ℝ) (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 2) *
   355	    Real.rpow e (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 512)
   356	  let c := Real.rpow (P.m : ℝ) (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 2) *
   357	    Real.rpow r (quantitativeLowDegreePower / 32)
   358	  let z := Real.rpow r quantitativeLowDegreePower
   359	  have ha : 0 ≤ a := by dsimp [a]; positivity
   360	  have hb : 0 ≤ b := by dsimp [b]; positivity
   361	  have hc : 0 ≤ c := by dsimp [c]; positivity
   362	  have hz : 0 ≤ z := by dsimp [z]; positivity
   363	  have hpassPow : Real.rpow passTerm s ≤
   364	      Real.rpow 2 s * (Real.rpow a s + Real.rpow b s +
   365	        Real.rpow c s + Real.rpow z s) := by
   366	    calc
   367	      Real.rpow passTerm s ≤ Real.rpow (2 * (a + b + c + z)) s :=
   368	        Real.rpow_le_rpow hpassTerm (by simpa only [a, b, c, z] using hpass') hs0
   369	      _ = Real.rpow 2 s * Real.rpow (a + b + c + z) s := by
   370	        exact Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num)
   371	          (add_nonneg (add_nonneg (add_nonneg ha hb) hc) hz) s
   372	      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
   373	        (rpow_add_four_le ha hb hc hz hs0 hs1) (Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _)
   374	  have haPow : Real.rpow a s =
   375	      Real.rpow e (quantitativeLowDegreePower * s / 16) := by
   376	    dsimp [a]
   377	    rw [rpow_rpow_eq he]
   378	    congr 1
   379	    ring
   380	  have hbPow : Real.rpow b s =
   381	      Real.rpow (P.m : ℝ) (quantitativeLowDegreePower * s / 2) *
   382	        Real.rpow e (quantitativeLowDegreePower * s / 512) := by
   383	    dsimp [b]
   384	    rw [Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (Real.rpow_nonneg he _) s,
   385	      rpow_rpow_eq (by positivity : 0 ≤ (P.m : ℝ)), rpow_rpow_eq he]
   386	    congr 1 <;> ring
   387	  have hcPow : Real.rpow c s =
   388	      Real.rpow (P.m : ℝ) (quantitativeLowDegreePower * s / 2) *
   389	        Real.rpow r (quantitativeLowDegreePower * s / 32) := by
   390	    dsimp [c]
   391	    rw [Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (Real.rpow_nonneg hr _) s,
   392	      rpow_rpow_eq (by positivity : 0 ≤ (P.m : ℝ)), rpow_rpow_eq hr]
   393	    congr 1 <;> ring
   394	  have hzPow : Real.rpow z s =
   395	      Real.rpow r (quantitativeLowDegreePower * s) := by
   396	    dsimp [z]
   397	    exact rpow_rpow_eq hr
   398	  have hfieldPow : Real.rpow
   399	      (Real.rpow field quantitativeLowDegreePower) s =
   400	      Real.rpow field (quantitativeLowDegreePower * s) := by
   401	    exact rpow_rpow_eq hfield
   402	  have htailPow : Real.rpow tail s = Real.exp (-(4 * h * d * s)) := by
   403	    dsimp [tail]
   404	    rw [← Real.exp_mul]
   405	    congr 1
   406	    ring
   407	  have hsumPow : Real.rpow
   408	      (passTerm + Real.rpow field quantitativeLowDegreePower + tail) s ≤
   409	      Real.rpow passTerm s +
   410	        Real.rpow (Real.rpow field quantitativeLowDegreePower) s +
   411	        Real.rpow tail s := by
   412	    exact (Real.rpow_add_le_add_rpow
   413	      (add_nonneg hpassTerm hfieldTerm) htail hs0 hs1).trans
   414	      (add_le_add (Real.rpow_add_le_add_rpow hpassTerm hfieldTerm hs0 hs1) le_rfl)
   415	  have hrawPow : Real.rpow raw s ≤
   416	      quantitativeNativeSeparatedRaw P e s := by
   417	    calc
   418	      Real.rpow raw s =
   419	          Real.rpow h (5 * s / 4) * Real.rpow d (s / 4) *
   420	            (Real.rpow 400000 s * Real.rpow
   421	              (passTerm + Real.rpow field quantitativeLowDegreePower + tail) s) := by
   422	        dsimp [raw]
   423	        rw [Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (by positivity) s,
   424	          Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (by positivity) s,
   425	          Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (Real.rpow_nonneg hh _) s,
   426	          rpow_rpow_eq hh, rpow_rpow_eq hd]
   427	        ring_nf
   428	      _ ≤ Real.rpow h (5 * s / 4) * Real.rpow d (s / 4) *
   429	          (Real.rpow 400000 s *
   430	            (Real.rpow passTerm s +
   431	              Real.rpow (Real.rpow field quantitativeLowDegreePower) s +
   432	              Real.rpow tail s)) := by
   433	        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
   434	          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
   435	            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsumPow (Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _))
   436	            (Real.rpow_nonneg hd _))
   437	          (Real.rpow_nonneg hh _)
   438	      _ ≤ Real.rpow h (5 * s / 4) * Real.rpow d (s / 4) *
   439	          (Real.rpow 400000 s *
   440	            (Real.rpow 2 s * (Real.rpow a s + Real.rpow b s +
   441	                Real.rpow c s + Real.rpow z s) +
   442	              Real.rpow (Real.rpow field quantitativeLowDegreePower) s +
   443	              Real.rpow tail s)) := by
   444	        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
   445	          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
   446	            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
   447	              (add_le_add (add_le_add hpassPow le_rfl) le_rfl)
   448	              (Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _))
   449	            (Real.rpow_nonneg hd _))
   450	          (Real.rpow_nonneg hh _)
   451	      _ = quantitativeNativeSeparatedRaw P e s := by
   452	        rw [haPow, hbPow, hcPow, hzPow, hfieldPow, htailPow]
   453	        dsimp [quantitativeNativeSeparatedRaw, h, d, field, r]
   454	        have hcoefficient : Real.rpow (800000 : ℝ) s =
   455	            Real.rpow 400000 s * Real.rpow 2 s := by
   456	          calc
   457	            Real.rpow (800000 : ℝ) s = Real.rpow (400000 * 2 : ℝ) s := by norm_num
   458	            _ = _ := Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (by norm_num) s
   459	        rw [hcoefficient]
   460	        ring
   461	  apply le_min
   462	  · calc
   463	      Real.rpow (directNativeError P.extendedDirectLd passing) s ≤
   464	          Real.rpow 1 s := Real.rpow_le_rpow hlambda0 (min_le_left _ _) hs0
   465	      _ = 1 := Real.one_rpow s
   466	  · exact (Real.rpow_le_rpow hlambda0 hlambdaRaw hs0).trans hrawPow

/-- The real power function `x ^ y`, defined as the real part of the complex power function.
For `x > 0`, it is equal to `exp (y log x)`. For `x = 0`, one sets `0 ^ 0=1` and `0 ^ y=0` for
`y ≠ 0`. For `x < 0`, the definition is somewhat arbitrary as it depends on the choice of a complex
determination of the logarithm. With our conventions, it is equal to `exp (y log x) cos (π y)`. -/
noncomputable def rpow (x y : ℝ) :=
  ((x : ℂ) ^ (y : ℂ)).re

noncomputable instance : Pow ℝ ℝ := ⟨rpow⟩

@[simp]
theorem rpow_eq_pow (x y : ℝ) : rpow x y = x ^ y := rfl

theorem rpow_def (x y : ℝ) : x ^ y = ((x : ℂ) ^ (y : ℂ)).re := rfl

theorem rpow_def_of_nonneg {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (y : ℝ) :
    x ^ y = if x = 0 then if y = 0 then 1 else 0 else exp (log x * y) := by
  simp only [rpow_def, Complex.cpow_def]; split_ifs <;>
  simp_all [(Complex.ofReal_log hx).symm, -Complex.ofReal_mul,
      (Complex.ofReal_mul _ _).symm, Complex.exp_ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_eq_zero]

/-!
# Quantitative global polynomial-pair construction

This module combines the native direct low-degree estimate with the existing
point and extended-line constructions. The resulting witness uses the actual
rounded polynomial-pair measurements at their concrete capped error. A
separate corollary records the polynomial envelope printed in the source.

## References

* `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1267-1404`
* blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`
-/

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open MIPStarRE.LDT

noncomputable section

/-- The projective global polynomial-pair witness at the concrete native
mixed error.  This construction uses no scalar comparison with a common
polynomial envelope. -/
theorem exists_quantitative_global_pair_witness_native
    (P : AdmissibleParams) (e : ℝ) (he : 0 ≤ e)
    (S : ProjectiveSetting P e) :
    let passing := directPassingErrorEnvelope
      (pauliBaselinePointError e + (P.m : ℝ) *
        pauliBaselineExtendedLineError e
          (((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) / (P.q : ℝ)))
      (((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) / (P.q : ℝ))
    let lambda := directNativeError P.extendedDirectLd passing
    Nonempty (GlobalPairWitness S
      (nativeGlobalPairError P lambda (pauliBaselinePointError e))) := by
  intro passing lambda
  obtain ⟨points⟩ := exists_combined_points_witness_explicit P e S
  obtain ⟨lines⟩ :=
    exists_extended_lines_witness_established_of_points_witness_explicit
      P e S points
  obtain ⟨pair⟩ := ExtendedLineGame.pair_witness_of_points_lines_at_native_error P e
    (pauliBaselinePointError e)
    ((P.m : ℝ) * pauliBaselineExtendedLineError e
      (((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) / (P.q : ℝ))) S points lines
  have hpassing : 0 ≤ passing := by
    dsimp [passing, directPassingErrorEnvelope]
    positivity
  have hlambda : 0 ≤ lambda := by
    dsimp only [lambda]
    exact direct_native_error_nonneg _ hpassing
  have hpoint : 0 ≤ pauliBaselinePointError e := by
    unfold pauliBaselinePointError
    exact mul_nonneg
      (le_trans zero_le_one one_le_pauli_baseline_point_constant)
      (Real.rpow_nonneg he _)
  refine ⟨{ pair with point_consistent_alice := ?_, point_consistent_bob := ?_ }⟩
  · intro W
    change _ ≤ nativeGlobalPairError P lambda (pauliBaselinePointError e)
    unfold nativeGlobalPairError
    refine le_min ?_ ?_
    · unfold consistencyDefect
      calc
        _ ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun _ => 1) :=
          avgOver_mono _ _ _ fun u => consistencyDefect_integrand_le_one
            S .AA' .BA'' (by trivial) _ _
        _ = 1 := avgOver_const_of_isProbability _
          (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) 1
    · simpa only [passing, lambda, Nat.cast_mul] using
        pair.point_consistent_alice W
  · intro W
    change _ ≤ nativeGlobalPairError P lambda (pauliBaselinePointError e)
    unfold nativeGlobalPairError
    refine le_min ?_ ?_
    · unfold consistencyDefect
      calc
        _ ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun _ => 1) :=
          avgOver_mono _ _ _ fun u => consistencyDefect_integrand_le_one
            S .BB' .AB'' (by trivial) _ _
        _ = 1 := avgOver_const_of_isProbability _
          (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) 1
    · simpa only [passing, lambda, Nat.cast_mul] using
        pair.point_consistent_bob W

/-- The quantitative global-pair witness at the concrete native mixed error.
The returned equality identifies the witness error with `nativeGlobalPairError`,
while the final inequality is only a common-envelope consequence. -/
theorem exists_quantitative_global_pair_witness_at_native_error
    (P : AdmissibleParams) (e : ℝ) (he : 0 ≤ e) (he1 : e ≤ 1)
    (hr1 : ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) / (P.q : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    (S : ProjectiveSetting P e) :
    let passing := directPassingErrorEnvelope
      (pauliBaselinePointError e + (P.m : ℝ) *
        pauliBaselineExtendedLineError e
          (((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) / (P.q : ℝ)))
      (((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) / (P.q : ℝ))
    let lambda := directNativeError P.extendedDirectLd passing
    ∃ g : ℝ,
      g = nativeGlobalPairError P lambda (pauliBaselinePointError e) ∧
      0 ≤ g ∧
      g ≤ 10000000 * (((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (4 : ℕ)) *
        quantitativeGlobalPairEnvelope P e ∧
      Nonempty (GlobalPairWitness S g) := by
  intro passing lambda
  let g := nativeGlobalPairError P lambda (pauliBaselinePointError e)
  have hpassing : 0 ≤ passing := by
    dsimp [passing, directPassingErrorEnvelope]
    positivity
  have hlambda : 0 ≤ lambda := by
    dsimp [lambda]
    exact direct_native_error_nonneg _ hpassing
  have hpoint : 0 ≤ pauliBaselinePointError e := by
    unfold pauliBaselinePointError
    exact mul_nonneg
      (le_trans zero_le_one one_le_pauli_baseline_point_constant)
      (Real.rpow_nonneg he _)
  have hbound := quantitative_native_global_pair_error_bound P e he he1 hr1
  have hw := exists_quantitative_global_pair_witness_native P e he S
  refine ⟨g, rfl, native_global_pair_error_nonneg P hlambda hpoint, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [g, passing, lambda] using hbound
  · simpa only [g, passing, lambda] using hw

/-- Weakening: the concrete native-error witness implies this fixed
polynomial-envelope form, matching the error shape printed in paper
`lem:qld-4-7`. -/
theorem exists_quantitative_global_pair_witness
    (P : AdmissibleParams) (e : ℝ) (he : 0 ≤ e) (he1 : e ≤ 1)
    (hr1 : ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) / (P.q : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    (S : ProjectiveSetting P e) :
    ∃ g : ℝ,
      0 ≤ g ∧
      g ≤ 10000000 * (((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (4 : ℕ)) *
        (Real.rpow e quantitativeGlobalPairPower +
          Real.rpow (P.q : ℝ) (-quantitativeGlobalPairPower) +
          Real.rpow 2
            (-(quantitativeGlobalPairPower * ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ)))) ∧
      Nonempty (GlobalPairWitness S g) := by
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg0, hbound, hpair⟩ :=
    exists_quantitative_global_pair_witness_at_native_error P e he he1 hr1 S
  refine ⟨g, hg0, ?_, hpair⟩
  simpa only [quantitativeGlobalPairEnvelope] using hbound

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Componentwise Pauli soundness bounds

The fixed-coefficient extraction estimates are retained separately through the
swap-isometry, Naimark, and raw-effect transfers. This module constructs one
soundness witness whose state and operator bounds use those stronger components
rather than the common extraction envelope.

## References

Paper `thm:pauli`,
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1426-1447`,
and the extraction and final transfer argument in
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1876`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open MIPStarRE.Quantum MagicSquareRigidity DistanceCalculus

noncomputable section

/-- A supplied global polynomial-pair witness determines one extraction
witness whose underlying auxiliary vector retains the stronger fixed-component
state and swapped-Pauli estimates. The extraction witness has common error
`18 * (x + sqrt x + r)`; the two displayed estimates retain the sharper
components for the same auxiliary vector.

**Unfaithful:** The global measurement is supplied as `GlobalPairWitness`,
rather than constructed from paper `lem:qld-4-7`. This is documented in
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_extraction-transfer.tex`, issue #123. Elimination: compose
this theorem with the construction of the global witness from the test hypotheses. -/
theorem exists_extraction_witness_with_component_bounds
    (P : AdmissibleParams) (epsilon deltaG : ℝ)
    (hepsilon : 0 ≤ epsilon) (hepsilon_one : epsilon ≤ 1) (hdeltaG : 0 ≤ deltaG)
    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) :
    let r : ℝ := ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q
    let x : ℝ := 2800 * (deltaG + Real.sqrt epsilon + r)
    ∃ v : ExtractionWitness S w (18 * (x + Real.sqrt x + r)),
      ‖S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat -
          S.idealExpState v.aux‖ ^ 2 ≤ 16 * x ∧
      ∀ (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind),
        opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
          (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
            conjBy (S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side))
              (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))
          (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
            S.placeExtractedRegister side (pauliProj W h))
          (S.idealExpState v.aux) ≤ 2 * x + 2 * r + 16 * Real.sqrt x := by
  let r : ℝ := ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q
  let x : ℝ := 2800 * (deltaG + Real.sqrt epsilon + r)
  change ∃ v : ExtractionWitness S w (18 * (x + Real.sqrt x + r)),
    ‖S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat -
        S.idealExpState v.aux‖ ^ 2 ≤ 16 * x ∧
    ∀ (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind),
      opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
        (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
          conjBy (S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side))
            (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))
        (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
          S.placeExtractedRegister side (pauliProj W h))
        (S.idealExpState v.aux) ≤ 2 * x + 2 * r + 16 * Real.sqrt x
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := by
    dsimp only [r]
    positivity
  have hx : 0 ≤ x := by
    dsimp only [x]
    positivity
  obtain ⟨aux, haux, hstate⟩ :=
    exists_extraction_aux_of_global_pair_witness_explicit
      P epsilon deltaG hepsilon hepsilon_one hdeltaG S w
  have hstate_x :
      ‖S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat -
          S.idealExpState aux‖ ^ 2 ≤ 16 * x := by
    simpa only [x, r, deltaConstructPaulis, pauliBaselineExtractionConstant] using hstate
  have hstate_norm :
      ‖S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat -
          S.idealExpState aux‖ ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt x := by
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hx, Real.sqrt_nonneg x, norm_nonneg
      (S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat -
        S.idealExpState aux)]
  have hcoefficient : 2 + 4 * Real.sqrt 172 ≤ (2800 : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (172 : ℝ),
      Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 172)]
  have hbase : 0 ≤ deltaG + Real.sqrt epsilon + r := by positivity
  have hconstruct :
      deltaConstructPaulis (2 + 4 * Real.sqrt 172)
          epsilon deltaG P.m P.d P.q ≤ x := by
    dsimp only [deltaConstructPaulis, x, r, pauliBaselineExtractionConstant]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoefficient hbase
  have hdefect (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) :
      S.evaluatedPauliDefect w side W ≤ x := by
    have hevaluated :=
      evaluated_pauli_tilde_consistency_of_global_pair_witness_explicit
        P epsilon deltaG hepsilon hepsilon_one hdeltaG S w W
    cases side with
    | alice => exact hevaluated.1.trans hconstruct
    | bob => exact hevaluated.2.trans hconstruct
  have hswap (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) :
      opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
        (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
          conjBy (S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side))
            (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))
        (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
          S.placeExtractedRegister side (pauliProj W h))
        (S.idealExpState aux) ≤ 2 * x + 2 * r + 16 * Real.sqrt x := by
    calc
      _ ≤ 2 * S.evaluatedPauliDefect w side W + 2 * r +
          4 * ‖S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat -
            S.idealExpState aux‖ := by
        simpa only [r, Nat.cast_mul] using S.extraction_pauli_dist_le w aux haux side W
      _ ≤ 2 * x + 2 * r + 16 * Real.sqrt x := by
        nlinarith [hdefect side W, hstate_norm]
  have hstate_scale :
      ‖S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat -
          S.idealExpState aux‖ ^ 2 ≤ 18 * (x + Real.sqrt x + r) := by
    nlinarith [hstate_x, Real.sqrt_nonneg x]
  have hswap_scale (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) :
      opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
        (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
          conjBy (S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side))
            (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))
        (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
          S.placeExtractedRegister side (pauliProj W h))
        (S.idealExpState aux) ≤ 18 * (x + Real.sqrt x + r) := by
    nlinarith [hswap side W, Real.sqrt_nonneg x]
  let v : ExtractionWitness S w (18 * (x + Real.sqrt x + r)) := {
    swap_right_unitary := swapUnitary_mul_conjTranspose w
    swap_left_unitary := conjTranspose_mul_swapUnitary w
    aux := aux
    aux_norm := haux
    state_close := hstate_scale
    pauli_close := hswap_scale
  }
  refine ⟨v, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [v] using hstate_x
  · intro side W
    simpa only [v] using hswap side W

/-- Componentwise transfer from a supplied global polynomial-pair witness to
one witness for the original arbitrary strategy. For
`x = 2800 * (deltaG + sqrt epsilon + md/q)`, the same witness has squared state
error at most `16*x` and both raw Pauli-family distances at most
`472*x + 24*(md/q) + 192*sqrt x + 344*epsilon`.

The proof keeps the actual state error through `ExtractionWitness.state_error_eq`
and `pauli_naimark_witness_state_distance_eq`, and supplies that actual norm to

  let G := nativeGlobalPairError P lambda (pauliBaselinePointError e)

/-- Explicit quantitative Pauli soundness with the degree-two common error
`min 4 (10^9 * (m*d)^2 * E_b)`, where `e = min epsilon 1` and
`b = 1 / 67108864`.

On the nonsaturated branch this theorem constructs a fresh global-pair and
component witness and retains the unsquared state norm and both raw sums of
squared operator errors for that same witness. -/
theorem pauli_soundness_quantitative_degree_two
    (P : AdmissibleParams) (epsilon : ℝ) (hepsilon : 0 ≤ epsilon)
    (R : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)) (hwin : 1 - epsilon ≤ R.value) :
    ∃ t : PauliSoundnessWitness P R,
      ‖isometryTensor t.φA t.φB R.ψ - idealState P t.aux‖ ≤
          pauliSoundnessQuantitativeDegreeTwoError P epsilon ∧
      (∀ W : PauliKind, rawPauliOperatorDistanceA P R t W ≤
        pauliSoundnessQuantitativeDegreeTwoError P epsilon) ∧
      ∀ W : PauliKind, rawPauliOperatorDistanceB P R t W ≤
        pauliSoundnessQuantitativeDegreeTwoError P epsilon := by
  let e := min epsilon 1
  have he : 0 ≤ e := by
    dsimp only [e]
    exact le_min hepsilon zero_le_one
  have he1 : e ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp only [e]
    exact min_le_right _ _
  have hwinE : 1 - e ≤ R.value := by
    by_cases hepsilon1 : epsilon ≤ 1
    · have heq : e = epsilon := by simp only [e, min_eq_left hepsilon1]
      rw [heq]
      exact hwin
    · have heq : e = 1 := by
        simp only [e, min_eq_right (le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hepsilon1))]
      rw [heq]
      simpa only [sub_self] using R.value_nonneg
  by_cases hsaturated :
      4 ≤ pauliSoundnessQuantitativeDegreeTwoRawError P e
  · obtain ⟨_, _, _, hbaseline⟩ := pauli_soundness_explicit_baseline
    obtain ⟨t, _, _, _⟩ := hbaseline P epsilon hepsilon R hwin
    have herror : pauliSoundnessQuantitativeDegreeTwoError P epsilon = 4 := by
      unfold pauliSoundnessQuantitativeDegreeTwoError
      change min 4 (pauliSoundnessQuantitativeDegreeTwoRawError P e) = 4
      exact min_eq_left hsaturated
    refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [herror]
      exact (pauli_soundness_state_distance_le_two P R t).trans (by norm_num)
